subject.title: Feature request: add a static/fixed menu bar icon option

question: Should CodexBar add a fourth static menu-bar style, and should it use a monochrome CodexBar glyph while retaining provider-status overlays?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but a fixed icon intentionally stops communicating live quota values and therefore changes the product's primary at-a-glance contract.

options.title: Add static template style
options.body: Add an opt-in monochrome CodexBar glyph that remains fixed while preserving incident and status overlays.

options.title: Keep usage-reactive icons
options.body: Retain the current styles so every menu-bar presentation continues to communicate provider usage.

recommendation.title: Add static template style
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in monochrome CodexBar glyph that remains fixed while preserving incident and status overlays.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository vision assigns new features to sign-off, and this person is most closely tied to the icon product contract.
